nodes.gap: Claims, release commits and static workpack manifests can diverge while several Grok/SOL chats work concurrently.
nodes.solution: Fresh-scan workpack-20, workpack-100, delta-190..219, claim files, release commits and current main; classify each node PASS_RELEASED, GAP_RESOLVABLE, CLAIMED, READY or VERIFIED_NO_NEED without changing product code.
nodes.acceptance: One deduplicated current-state matrix with node id, owner, exact state, evidence SHA/run/job and next valid dependency.

nodes.gap: Several required segment improvements are tested in isolation or still pending dependency chains; optional OSS work must not delay operation.
nodes.solution: Complete only dependency-satisfied required nodes from F-FE-069..089 and F-FE-174..188 that materially affect shell, browser, editor, touch, IO/import, remote/HF. Optional components may end VERIFIED_NO_NEED.
nodes.acceptance: Every segment needed by the candidate has a latest PASS_RELEASED version; no required node remains TESTED_NOT_WIRED without an integrator handoff.

nodes.gap: The Factory cannot be called functional while visible enabled controls are untested or only checked for existence/clickability.
nodes.solution: Finish applicable CONTROL_QA F-FE-090..154 plus discovery/matrix nodes F-FE-201..211. Each control must prove a canonical state/UI/output effect; disabled controls need a visible deterministic reason.
nodes.acceptance: 100% of discovered controls map to PASS, GAP with owner, or valid deterministic disabled reason; zero unmapped enabled controls.

nodes.gap: Shell versions, mobile fit, docks, focus/inert and reduced-motion work exist separately.
nodes.solution: Consolidate evidence from F-FE-068/070/071/174/175/214/215; repair only real shell gaps, then release one latest shell segment version.
nodes.acceptance: 390/412/768 widths fit without masking overflow; drawers are touch/keyboard usable; focus restores; no trapped focus; reduced-motion respected.

nodes.gap: Editor controls, layers, keyboard operations and multiselect are split across isolated versions and tests.
nodes.solution: Validate F-FE-074/075/076/089 plus core control QA and F-FE-213 against the single existing reducer/history/state engine; repair only failing owner segment.
nodes.acceptance: Create/select/move/resize/duplicate/delete/layer/group/property/undo/redo all use one canonical state and survive required reload/undo paths.

nodes.gap: Touch fixes have passed isolated tests but must coexist with scroll, pinch, resize and mobile controls.
nodes.solution: Run latest F-FE-072/073/178/179 and F-FE-214 together on phone/tablet viewports; patch only SEG-04 on reproducible failure.
nodes.acceptance: Tap/select, drag, scroll, resize, cancel and pinch do not steal each other; no phantom drag; touch targets usable.

nodes.gap: Import, versions, JSON/HTML export and reload recovery are individually implemented/tested but not yet accredited together on one candidate.
nodes.solution: Converge F-FE-079..084, 081..083, 152..164, 182..185, 212; verify malformed input fail-closed, semantic roundtrip, autosave/recovery and destination status/retry.
nodes.acceptance: Import/edit/save/reload/reopen/export/restore/destination roundtrip has no silent loss or fake success.

nodes.gap: AI skill/model/team, remote health and HF jobs need one coherent frontend behavior with explicit failure states and no secret exposure.
nodes.solution: Converge F-FE-085..087, 165..175, 186..188, 216..218 against existing typed router/remote boundaries; no frontend router duplication.
nodes.acceptance: Available/disabled/running/success/error/cancel/offline states are explicit; secret_ref only; no raw token in DOM/localStorage; failures do not corrupt project state.

nodes.gap: The component inventory is large, but most source presence is not runtime integration and many components are optional for the current Factory.
nodes.solution: Use F-FE-155..173, 190..200 only for demonstrated capability gaps. Reuse existing extraction/copy motors and thin adapters; mark non-required monoliths VERIFIED_NO_NEED rather than integrating for count.
nodes.acceptance: Every component claimed as integrated has source/ref/license -> adapter -> wiring -> runtime test evidence; optional components cannot block candidate closure.

nodes.gap: Current PASS evidence is distributed across isolated/versioned segment files; the last known integrated candidate family predates several newer releases.
nodes.solution: SEG-11 alone composes a new additive candidate from only latest PASS_RELEASED/VERIFIED_NO_NEED segment versions, preserving frozen historical entrypoints and recording exact component blobs.
nodes.acceptance: One candidate entrypoint/bootstrap has deterministic segment manifest and boots without page/console/module errors on desktop and mobile.

nodes.gap: Isolated PASS cannot prove the assembled candidate works end-to-end.
nodes.solution: Run F-UI-051..061 plus applicable F-FE-201..219 on the exact candidate SHA: all five steps, controls, desktop/mobile/touch/keyboard, reload/reopen, import/export, router/remote/HF, offline and error states.
nodes.acceptance: All required gates PASS on the same exact SHA; all discovered controls have real effects; critical console/network errors = 0.

nodes.gap: Any global regression failure must be fixed without broad rewrites or parallel workers touching the same product path.
nodes.solution: For each reproducible failure create/claim exactly one owner-segment GAP node, apply a distinct minimal StrategyDelta, focused test it, release it, then return to SEG-11 composition and rerun global regression.
nodes.acceptance: No unresolved critical failure remains; every repair has before/after evidence and no same-strategy retry loop.

nodes.gap: A local/CI candidate is not a delivered Factory until the exact tested commit is published and read back.
nodes.solution: Publish the exact candidate commit that passed global regression; do not rebuild from a moving main. Record published SHA, artifact/deployment id and browser readback.
nodes.acceptance: TESTED_SHA == PUBLISHED_SHA and deployed desktop/mobile readback matches the tested candidate blobs.

nodes.gap: Producer/integrator evidence is not sufficient for final accreditation.
nodes.solution: An independent reviewer replays critical journeys and verifies exact published SHA, evidence integrity, mobile/touch/keyboard behavior, controls, persistence/export and no hidden failures.
nodes.acceptance: F-UI-062 PASS with reviewer independent of the final producer/integrator and evidence linked to exact published SHA.

nodes.gap: Global frontend closure has not yet been certified.
nodes.solution: Run the existing F-UI-063 Final Judge only after every required closure node and independent review pass; do not add features at this stage.
nodes.acceptance: F-UI-063 VERIFIED_CLOSED; TESTED_SHA == PUBLISHED_SHA; no critical GAP; only then declare FRONTEND_100.
